chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Ash'ari, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Barqi, from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from Yahya ibn 'Imran al-Halabi, from Ayyub ibn al-Hurr, who said:
I heard Abu 'Abdillah عليه السلام saying:

Indeed Allah, Mighty is His remembrance, sealed the prophets with your Prophet, so there will never be any prophet after him; and He sealed the books with your Book, so there will never be any book after it. And He sent down in it the clarification of everything: your creation and the creation of the heavens and the earth, the account of those before you, the judgment of what is among you, the news of what will come after you, the matter of Paradise and the Fire, and what you are ultimately going to.

key_terms.نَبِيِّكُمُ: your Prophet, referring to Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith describe the finality of prophethood and the completeness of the Qur'an?
ai.summary: This hadith affirms that Allah ended prophethood with Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and ended revealed books with the Qur'an. It also presents the Qur'an as containing clarification regarding creation, past nations, present judgments, future events, and the realities of Paradise and the Fire.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya Al Ashary, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Barqy, from Al Nazar Bin Suweyd, from Yahya Bin Imran Al Halby, from Ayoub Bin Al Hurr who said,

‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, Mighty is His<sup>azwj</sup> Mention, Ended the Prophets<sup>as</sup> by your Prophet<sup>saww</sup>, therefore there will not be a Prophet<sup>saww</sup> after him<sup>saww</sup>, ever! And He<sup>azwj</sup> Ended the Books by your Book (Quran), therefore there will not be a Book after it, ever! And He<sup>azwj</sup> Revealed in it the clarification of everything, and Created you all and Created the skied and the earth, and Gave you news of what (transpired) before you, and Decisions of what is between you, and news of what is to be after you, and the matter of the Paradise and the Fire, and what you are going towards’.
en.sarwar: 3. Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Ash’ari has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Barqi from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd from Yahya ibn ‘Imran al-Halabi from Ayyub ibn al-Hurr who has said that he heard abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) say the following.
“Allah, Majestic is Whose mention, ended with your prophet the (coming of) the prophets. Thus, there will never come any prophet after him.

With your book He ended sending of (heavenly) books. Thus, there will never come other heavenly books. In it (your book) He has placed clarifications for all things, such as your creation and the creation of the heavens and the earth. Therein is the news of the beings before you, the laws that help settle your disputes and the news of the beings that come into being after you, the news of the issues of Paradise and Fire and that to which you proceed.”
